newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to restore forest to its former owners.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to restore forest to its former owners.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet on Monday approved a draft bill aimed at restoring to its former owners forest land collectivised under communist rule.

"The government approved today a draft bill allowing former owners to restore their ownership over forest expropriated by the state since 1944," Agriculture Minister Ventsislav Varbanov told reporters after a cabinet session.
Restitution of property since the end of communist rule in 1989 has not so far covered forests.
Under the bill, former owners whose actual forests could not be returned are to be compensated through forests in different regions or through vouchers, Varbanov said.
Foreigners will not be allowed to acquire ownership over forests.
The draft bill will be submitted to parliament for approval in September after the summer recess.
